# wget2 / libwget_hpkp_fuzzer

wget2's own fuzz target `libwget_hpkp_fuzzer` ([source](source/libwget_hpkp_fuzzer.c), unmodified), one of the targets OSS-Fuzz builds, over wget2 (gitlab.com/gnuwget/wget2 at ea0f0e19).

wget_hpkp_db_load of the input (fopen of "hpkp" redirected to fmemopen), then wget_hpkp_db_check_pubkey; result discarded.

## How this program differs from what OSS-Fuzz runs
- Linked against wget2 at commit ea0f0e19.
- In every build, getenv() returns NULL, getpid() returns 1 and mkstemp() uses a fixed name, so the program depends only on its input.
- A small driver reads the input file, calls the harness one to four times and prints each return value.

## What the harness checks
The harness makes no check of its own beyond not crashing, so a statement about it says only that the code it calls never crashes, hangs or trips a sanitizer.

## Builds
Static riscv64 Linux programs, compiled for RV64G and run as `<file> <input-file>`; `oft fetch wget2` downloads the published ones and checks each against its SHA-256.

| build | file | bytes | sha256 |
|---|---|---:|---|
| plain | `libwget_hpkp_fuzzer.plain` | 138,800 | `ed23e883940f8fdaad0fe09ff2cb495b9987b39f9be4ddbb7ea4a255cb47f7ff` |
| ubsan | `libwget_hpkp_fuzzer.ubsan` | 143,176 | `b7d86e5f0bfadc2fab2b5148a288b54b7664ef46ee4ca46a3a6f7d8f995212c3` |
| asan | `libwget_hpkp_fuzzer.asan` | 700,952 | `04286aa662c65048dff4717fc85612cf74f96e0c4eee154645c531caf28af86e` |
| asan-ubsan | `libwget_hpkp_fuzzer.asan-ubsan` | 706,360 | `9f767ede3b904ef598ecaf2e69f1c9033db2612983567e2924b4cfb45c10214b` |

Each build also links code that no sanitizer instruments, as its link recorded it. A statement about a sanitizer build covers that code only as uninstrumented code: ASan checks no load or store made inside it, and UBSan inserts no check there.

- plain: `clang_rt.crtbegin.o` (compiler-rt), `libclang_rt.builtins.a` (compiler-rt), `crt1.o` (the C library), `libc.a` (the C library), `libnettle.a` (a library from the build image)
- ubsan: `clang_rt.crtbegin.o` (compiler-rt), `libclang_rt.builtins.a` (compiler-rt), `crt1.o` (the C library), `libc.a` (the C library), `libnettle.a` (a library from the build image)
- asan: `clang_rt.crtbegin.o` (compiler-rt), `libclang_rt.asan.a` (the sanitizer runtime), `libclang_rt.builtins.a` (compiler-rt), `crt1.o` (the C library), `libc.a` (the C library), `libnettle.a` (a library from the build image), `libunwind.a` (the C++ runtime)
- asan-ubsan: `clang_rt.crtbegin.o` (compiler-rt), `libclang_rt.asan.a` (the sanitizer runtime), `libclang_rt.builtins.a` (compiler-rt), `crt1.o` (the C library), `libc.a` (the C library), `libnettle.a` (a library from the build image), `libunwind.a` (the C++ runtime)
